Metadata.title: Marvel Orleans - Student & Developer
Metadata.desc: Marvel Orleans is a developer building digital projects and exploring his passion for systems and the web. Take a look at his work and what he's learning.

about.title: Who Am I?
about.desc: Hey, Marvel Orleans here. 👋 I'm a college student in Indonesia with a passion in programming. I've been teaching myself to code for about 3 years now, and I've built some projects to show for it. Got a project you'd like to work on? Feel free to contact me.

mallocInC.title: Malloc-in-C
mallocInC.desc: A custom C memory allocator implementing malloc, calloc, realloc, and free with sbrk, mmap, 16-byte alignment, and built-in debugging tools.

animatedMatrices.title: Animated Matrices
animatedMatrices.desc: A tool to help students learn matrices in linear algebra visually and interactively.

croquisImageReferences.title: Croquis Desktop App
croquisImageReferences.desc: A reference-sketching tool used daily by a professional artist.

seaPortfolioSite.title: Sea Portfolio Site
seaPortfolioSite.desc: Created a fully responsive portfolio site, collaborating closely with the client through every stage of design and development. Delivered a polished final product that met all requirements, included two client revisions, and worked across devices and browsers.

mallocInC.title: Malloc-in-C
mallocInC.desc: A from-scratch implementation of C's dynamic memory allocator. Reimplements malloc, calloc, realloc, and free using both sbrk and mmap, with 16-byte alignment, guard canaries, and custom debugging tools for inspecting allocator state.

miniPaintTui.title: Mini Paint TUI
miniPaintTui.desc: A terminal-based pixel art editor written in C. Features a 32×32 canvas, drawing and fill tools, low-level keyboard input using termios, and export to PPM with optional PNG/JPG conversion with FFmpeg.

nextjsPortfolioSite.title: NextJS Portfolio Site
nextjsPortfolioSite.desc: A personal portfolio built with React and TypeScript, featuring internationalization, theming, and reusable UI components. Designed as a production-ready website rather than a one-off showcase. Design inspired by Tim Gatzke (tim-gatzke.de), rebuilt and iterated upon.

simplePortfolioSite.title: Simple Portfolio Site
simplePortfolioSite.desc: Designed a personal portfolio site using standard HTML, CSS, and JS—focused on simplicity and learning core web development skills.

animatedMatrices.title: Animated Matrices
animatedMatrices.desc: An interactive web app for visualizing 2D linear transformations. Create vectors, build custom matrices, and explore transformations step by step with undo/redo, inverse operations, and repeatable matrix applications. Open source on GitHub.

croquisImageReferences.title: Croquis Image References
croquisImageReferences.desc: A reference-sketching tool built for a professional artist and refined through regular feedback. Features customizable timers, keyboard shortcuts, image queue management, and workflow-focused settings for gesture drawing sessions.
